name: Dentaneosuchus
sum: Dentaneosuchus is a large sebecid crocodylomorph from the Middle Eocene of Issel and Réalmont, France, first named as Atacisaurus.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Remains from the Sables du Castrais.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
